title: A card grows to fit its title the way a button does
goal: A button and a badge now get wider when their words get longer. The card, the nav bar and the text field do not, so a long card title still runs past the edge of the card. Give the remaining starter components the same behaviour, in whichever direction actually makes sense for each one.
notes: Follows the container-hug work landed 2026-09-04 (docs/design/ui-building.md, "A container closes around its contents"). The card needs a real layout decision: its Picture is currently placement .fill, which the new rules would read as the surface behind everything, so it likely wants a column stack (Background as the surface, Picture stretched across, Title and Body as rows) rather than a free hug. StarterComponents.layout is where each ones sizing lives.
acceptance: A card given a longer title or body grows taller and keeps its room, rather than the words running past it
A nav bar keeps its width and its title stays centred when the title gets longer
A text field keeps its width, and its placeholder does not run past the box
Each starter says in one sentence which of its sides is the size of its contents and which is a number it was given
